io.name: Import / export
io.description: Text, CSV, JSON, Quizlet and Anki import; exports, deck packages, backups and printing.

import.detected: Detected automatically ({confidence}). Change if it looks wrong.
import.source_hint: Paste rows of text or choose a file; check the preview before importing.

export.format_hint: Deck packages keep everything; text and JSON keep only the notes.
export.include_history_hint: Lets another device continue exactly where you are.

backup.hint: A backup holds the whole collection: notes, cards, history, classifications, settings and media.
backup.confirm_body: Backup from {date} with {notes} notes. The current collection is backed up first, then replaced.
backup.incompatible: This backup comes from a newer version of the app.
backup.restored: Restored. The previous state was saved to {path}.
backup.create_hint: Saves one .fcbackup file you can keep anywhere.
backup.restore_hint: Replaces the current collection; it is backed up first.

print.hint: Fronts and backs are on alternating pages, mirrored for double-sided printing.

issue.anki_skipped_reviews: {count} review log entries were skipped (manual reschedules).
issue.anki_missing_media: {count} media files are missing from the package.
issue.invalid_notetype: A note type in the package is invalid.
issue.notetype_no_cards: This row makes no cards with this note type (for example a cloze row without a cloze deletion).
issue.attributes_disabled: Classifications are turned off: the package's classifications were not imported.
issue.attribute_not_applicable: This classification does not apply to the deck.
issue.attribute_unknown_option: Unknown option “{value}” (it can be created automatically).

io.intro: Bring cards in, take them out, back up the whole collection or print a deck.

validation.import_format: The file is not in the expected format or is damaged.
validation.text_options: The separators are empty or overlap.

conflict.unsupported_version: This file comes from a newer version of the app.
